Every fact the seven hand typed sports files show a player, checked on 2026-09-19 against two independent sources, one of them official wherever the official source would answer. scripts/simSportsFacts.mjs holds the shipped files to this record and fails if either side moves. Wikipedia is never a source here. A fact that carries "noOfficial" stands on two independent sources because the official one was unreachable, silent or wrong, and says which.

Harry Vardon.note: Born Grouville, Jersey, Channel Islands; sporting nationality is recorded as Jersey (not England/France) despite English father and French mother.

Jim Barnes.note: Born Lelant, Cornwall, England; moved to the U.S. in 1906 and played the rest of his career there. Sources are split on whether he ever naturalized, but his sporting nationality is consistently recorded as England.

Tommy Armour.note: Born Edinburgh, Scotland; emigrated and naturalized U.S. citizen in 1923. Non-Wikipedia sources (Scotsman.com, Scottish Sports Hall of Fame) describe his sporting nationality as recorded as both Scotland and United States; file's choice of United States is a defensible but not the only convention in use.

Sandy Lyle.note: Born Shrewsbury, England to Scottish parents; represented England at schoolboy/junior/amateur level but chose to represent Scotland on turning professional, and is recorded under Scotland thereafter.
